mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user_id AS userId, 'post' AS boardType, p.post_type AS postType, NULL AS countryId, p.title, p.views, p.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comments pc WHERE pc.post_id = p.id AND pc.deleted = 0 ) AS commentCount FROM user_posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id

SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, 'course' AS boardType, NULL AS postType, c.country_id AS countryId, c.title, c.views, c.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_comments cc WHERE cc.course_id = c.id AND cc.deleted = 0 ) AS commentCount FROM courses c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id

WHERE p.deleted = 0
UNION ALL
WHERE c.deleted = 0

WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.post_type IN ('QUESTION', 'TIP') AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT board.id, board.userId, board.boardType, board.postType, board.title, board.commentCount, board.nickname, board.createdAt, board.views, COALESCE(bookmarkCounts.bookmarkCount, 0) AS bookmarkCount FROM (
) board LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.target_type, b.target_id, COUNT(*) AS bookmarkCount FROM bookmarks b WHERE b.target_type IN ('POST', 'COURSE') GROUP BY b.target_type, b.target_id ) bookmarkCounts ON bookmarkCounts.target_id = board.id AND bookmarkCounts.target_type = CASE WHEN board.boardType = 'course' THEN 'COURSE' ELSE 'POST' END WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY board.createdAt ASC, board.boardType ASC, board.id ASC
ORDER BY board.views DESC, board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY board.commentCount DESC, board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY bookmarkCount DESC, board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
ORDER BY board.createdAt DESC, board.boardType ASC, board.id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
